problem_text:
A logistics coordinator must orchestrate the dispatch of relief supplies from regional distribution centers to crisis-affected zones, with the objective of minimizing total delivery expense.

The stockpile available at each distribution center (set C) is as follows:
*C1 holds 79 units.
*C2 holds 185 units.
*C3 holds 180 units.
*C4 holds 99 units.
*C5 holds 139 units.
*C6 holds 139 units.
*C7 holds 87 units.

The urgent requirement to be satisfied at each crisis zone (set Z) is detailed below:
*Z1 requires 28 units.
*Z2 requires 37 units.
*Z3 requires 113 units.
*Z4 requires 142 units.
*Z5 requires 122 units.
*Z6 requires 33 units.
*Z7 requires 144 units.

The per-unit transit cost from each distribution center to every zone is provided in the matrix:
| From / To | Z1 | Z2 | Z3 | Z4 | Z5 | Z6 | Z7 |
|--|-|-|-|-|-|-|
| C1 | 16 | 15 | 19 | 19 | 15 | 19 | 20 |
| C2 | 11 | 11 | 5 | 15 | 3 | 16 | 15 |
| C3 | 10 | 9 | 19 | 2 | 12 | 17 | 3 |
| C4 | 10 | 15 | 15 | 2 | 2 | 12 | 10 |
| C5 | 3 | 3 | 20 | 20 | 17 | 13 | 15 |
| C6 | 19 | 18 | 2 | 15 | 19 | 7 | 11 |
| C7 | 20 | 16 | 17 | 5 | 2 | 15 | 4 |

Determine the optimal allocation of shipments to achieve the minimal aggregate expenditure.
